issues.description: Q3 passage had duplicated text: '③<u>it was through infectious imitation, rather than an understanding of its long-term benefit, which</u>, rather than an understanding of its long-term benefit, that agriculture...' — 'rather than an understanding of its long-term benefit' appeared twice, creating garbled student-facing text. The <u> tag wrapped the entire clause instead of just the error word.
issues.resolution: FIXED — ③<u>which</u> now marks only the error word. Passage reads correctly with single occurrence of 'rather than...' phrase.

issues.description: Q1 ans=2 (predisposing→predisposed). Grammar point (parallel structure with be + p.p.) is clear and unambiguous. No alternative answer possible. All 4 markers are well-distributed across the passage.
Q2 ans=2 (seeing→to see). 'be set up to V' requires infinitive. Clear grammar point. ③ 'are replicated' is unambiguously correct passive. No dual-answer risk.

Q4 부적절 어휘. ③ detrimental→beneficial. The contrast with 'useful' in previous sentence and 'make sense' in same sentence makes beneficial the only logical choice. Detrimental is clearly wrong — the passage argues memes don't need to be useful/beneficial, not that they don't need to be harmful.

Q5 부적절 어휘. ② deliberate→infectious. 'rather than an understanding' creates a contrast structure where the left side should be NON-deliberate/unconscious. 'deliberate imitation' would collapse the rather than contrast with 'understanding'. Well-constructed distractor.

Q6 빈칸추론. All 3 wrong choices (rational planning/gradual adaptation/conscious decision) are fabricated phrases not from the passage. However, the connectors (as well as, in addition to, along with) vs 'rather than' provide good structural clues. The blank includes both content + connector, so students must use passage context. Acceptable but overkill differentiation via connector alone.
issues.resolution: ACCEPTABLE — validate B-level warning noted. Connectors provide legitimate grammatical reasoning beyond just vocabulary.

issues.description: Q7 빈칸추론. Wrong choices (comfortable existence/rewarding journey/promising venture) are all positive descriptions contradicting 'for no obvious benefit'. The answer 'a risky life of endless toil' is directly from passage. Students could eliminate by seeing 'for no obvious benefit' alone without reading the full passage.
issues.resolution: ACCEPTABLE — the question tests whether students can find the right expression for the blank. The surrounding context 'for no obvious benefit' is a legitimate passage clue, not answer leakage.

issues.description: Q8 내용일치. All 4 choices clearly differentiated. ③ (곱셈표+유용하지 않은 것도 퍼진다) matches S4 directly. Wrong choices contradict specific passage statements.
Q9 내용불일치. ① states farming saves energy — directly contradicts 'far more energy and time'. Clear and unambiguous.
Q10 내용불일치. ④ states farmer chose with obvious benefit expectation — contradicts 'for no obvious benefit'. Clear and unambiguous.
Q11 주제. ② correctly identifies innate imitation + meme spread. Other choices focus on partial aspects (감각기관/농업이익/에너지효율). Well-structured.
Q12 요지. English choices well-differentiated. ③ captures full argument. ①②④ each contradict passage claims.

Q13 함축의미. ① correctly interprets the risky-life phrase as evidence of meme power over rationality. Other choices misread the tone (courage/devotion/natural transition). Underline target properly marked.
Q14 지칭추론 (them). Korean choices. S3 'see and hear things and then to set about imitating them' — them clearly refers to things (보고 들은 것들). No ambiguity.

Q15 지칭추론 (its). S8 'its long-term benefit' — its refers to agriculture (the subject of the that-clause). Tricky because agriculture appears after its, but standard cataphoric reference in cleft sentences. No dual-answer risk.

Q16 서술형 찾기. wa='the physical hosts needed for memes to spread' (8단어). stem says 8단어, wa=8 words. wa exists in passage. Stem asks for the phrase describing humans' role for meme spread — unique answer.
Q17 서술형 찾기. wa='a risky life of endless toil for no obvious benefit' (10단어). stem says 10단어, wa=10 words. wa exists in passage. Unique answer.

Q18 핵심단어 찾기. wa='innately prepared to learn certain behaviours and predisposed' (8단어). stem says 8단어, wa=8 words. wa exists in passage (찾기형). Stem correctly identifies the target as the explanation of 'prepared learning'. Accept array includes shorter version too.

Q19 조건영작. wa='does not need to be useful to the host' (9단어). Condition lists: be, does, host, need, not, the, to, to, useful (9 tokens, 'to' appears twice — matches wa). Word count 9 matches. All condition words present in wa. wa NOT in passage (passage has blank). Korean clue provided.

Q20 조건영작. wa='uses far more energy and time than hunting and gathering' (10단어). Condition lists: and, and, energy, far, gathering, hunting, more, than, time, uses (10 tokens, 'and' appears twice — matches wa). Word count 10 matches. All condition words present in wa. wa NOT in passage. Korean clue provided.

summary: 20문항 적대적 공격 완료. HIGH 1건(Q3 passage 텍스트 중복 — 수정 완료), MEDIUM 2건(Q6/Q7 오답이 fullPassage 외 표현이나 구조적 단서가 있어 허용), LOW 17건(이슈 없음). Q3 수정 후 validate PASS 확인. 정답 분포: 1번=2개, 2번=5개, 3번=5개, 4번=3개 (한도 내). 최대 연속 동일 정답=2개 (한도 내).
